blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines has requested six CH-47 Chinook heavy-lift helicopters from the United States under a proposed $2-billion military financing package, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said Thursday. Teodoro said all six brand-new helicopters could be delivered as early as 2029 if Washington agrees to prioritize the Philippine order. “Nag-request kami sa US government doon sa $2-billion financing ng anim na Chinook. That is the only thing I can disclose out of that package (We made a request to the US government regarding the $2-billion financing for six Chinooks.
